correctness.rationale: The 16-state CTMC generator exactly matches independent recovery and per-edge infection; absorption occurs a.s. for finite graphs. The extracted verifier independently solves twelve rational instances using a separate Fraction Gaussian elimination, and the required continuity/integral argument is exact. No numerical sampling is promoted to a proof.

value.rationale: For tree order at most three the topology choice is unique, whereas the two natural four-site, three-edge habitat/epidemic networks exhibit a strict mean persistence ordering for all positive rates and all four uniform occupancy counts, but short-horizon rankings oppose it for three distinct counts. This is a sharp, complete and scientifically motivated minimal network benchmark for finite-deadline versus average persistence; no generalization to larger graphs or clinical/ecological policy is implied.
